accessibility.evidence: Navigation labels and image alternatives were inspected in the browser accessibility tree. Work collection, source-board disclosure, mobile menu and language chooser were exercised by keyboard. Header targets were enlarged to 44px. Empty form submission exposes an alert and marks required fields invalid. A full screen-reader, contrast and reduced-motion browser-emulation sweep was not completed.

responsive.evidence: Home, Work, About, CV, Contact and all 14 cases were checked at 390px and 1440px; tablet-width routes were checked at 768px. No horizontal overflow or broken first-viewport image was observed. Editorial maps were checked at narrow and wide widths. This is responsive QA, not visual regression against baselines.

loading.reason: The revised homepage and editorial case sections contain static content.

empty.reason: The revised sections do not accept user data or render a variable list that can be empty.

error.evidence: Submitting the contact form empty displayed a visible warning with role=alert and aria-invalid on the required fields. No real message was sent.

partial.evidence: The case narratives explicitly identify limits of the available evidence instead of presenting missing outcomes as proven.

success.evidence: Homepage case and collection links were visible; Work collection switched by touch and keyboard, source archives opened and closed with Enter, XY case tabs switched between #protocols and #xygo, and the XYGO film played in view, paused offscreen and resumed.

permission.reason: No permission-gated action exists in the revised static sections.
